pipelines.name: baseline
pipelines.description: Standard OpenAI agent using structured outputs.

pipelines.name: enriched-schema
pipelines.description: Baseline + enriched schema prompt (field cards + Pydantic-like code).

pipelines.name: simple-clean-schema
pipelines.description: One-call baseline-plus with improved prompting and cleaned prompt schema; original schema is still used for structured output.

pipelines.name: inline-reasoning
pipelines.description: One-call pipeline with top-level field reasoning wrappers in the generation schema, unwrapped to final values. Optional one-shot example.

pipelines.name: enriched-inline-reasoning
pipelines.description: Inline reasoning wrappers plus compact Pydantic-like schema prompt with Reasoned[T]/Nullable[T].

pipelines.name: enriched-inline-reasoning-deep
pipelines.description: Enriched inline reasoning with recursive Reasoned[T] wrappers for all fields, subfields, and array items.

pipelines.name: enriched-inline-reasoning-self-consistency
pipelines.description: Multi-sample enriched inline reasoning with modular schema-aware self-consistency over scalars, objects, and arrays.
